item.title: 001 - A private conversation
item.description: 要求 内化单词 + 语法 + 习惯用法。 听力 + 口语 + 写作练习 Bilibili 课前问题 [[how-to-create-a-sentence|如何根据格式造句]] 1. 课文 Last week, I went to the theater. I had a very good seat. The play was interesting. But I did not enjoy it. A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me. They were talking loudly.

item.title: n2l02 - Breakfast or lunch
item.description: 课前问题 be+doing vs do/does 感叹句？ 如何确定频率副词 adv. 的位置？ Always (100%) → Usually → Often/Frequently → Sometimes → Occasionally → Rarely/Seldom → Hardly ever → Never (0%) 课文 It was Sunday. I never get up early on Sundays. I sometimes stay in bed until lunch time. Last Sunday, I got up very late. I looked out of the window. It’s dark outside.

item.title: n2l12 - Goodbye and good luck
item.description: 课前问题 课文 Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow. We’ll meet him at the harbour early in the morning. He will be in his small boat, Topsail. Topsail is a famous boat. It has sailed across the Atlantic many times. Capiton Alison will set out at eight o’clock, so we have plenty of time. We’ll see his boat and then say goodbye to him.
